$comment: Severity and alert thresholds. ADR-9: all air values are PM2.5 in micrograms per cubic metre, never AQI.

access.$comment: The line that defines underserved, used by the access surface, the optimiser, and every exposure count.

trust.$comment: At or above this a report renders as a solid marker. Below it renders hollow and dashed, labelled unconfirmed. Low-trust reports are LABELLED, never hidden.
